info.title: Jobman Dashboard
info.description: Monitoring-only private client API. In-progress contract; operation presence does not claim implementation. No arbitrary Control proxy or execution mutations. All resource reads require current source authority. Unknown source enum strings remain valid.

post.description: First phase: reserve a client-generated opaque credential ID and secret, persisted in Keychain before request. If-None-Match:* creates an unbound installation; otherwise positive If-Match. Exact same pair for the unchanged target is idempotent even after a lost receipt; revoked IDs never reassign. Acknowledge and persist receipt before bind/switch/activate. At most 500 retained IDs per installation, 5 pending and 5 per target binding. 512-byte strict JSON.

post.description: Detach-only native sign-out. No Authorization, Cookie, Origin, query, or conditional headers. 512-byte strict body. Known pending credentials cancel admission; known exact current targets detach atomically. Unknown/wrong/stale credentials return identical empty 204 and allocate no rows. 5-second deadline, 8 concurrent requests, per-replica 60/sec burst120. Retry 429/503; never discard queued credential on failure.

executionUnavailableReason.description: Why submitted command detail is unavailable: missing, unsupported, or too_large. Future values remain inspectable. Omitted when execution is present.

Target.description: Configured execution target. State and advertised capabilities are configuration facts, not health, utilization or capacity. Unknown string enums remain displayable.

Artifact.description: Published metadata; metadata_only does not establish byte availability. No storage path or download URL is returned.

Citation.description: Exact sealed citation data. Item JSON is a string to preserve wide numeric values. Byte offsets address sanitized artifact data; original source offsets are only included when exact. No current log read occurs.

state.description: Mutable task state; outdated independently describes the recorded snapshot.

name.description: Trimmed, nonempty UTF-8 name, at most120 encoded bytes; no control characters.

RuleInput.description: Complete personal intent. Maximum64KiB request. All arrays required, including empty arrays. Explicit namespaces span at most32 deployments; watched_jobs requires1–100 job references within selected namespaces. selected requires individual outcomes; all_terminal preserves future unknown outcomes. Server canonicalizes ordering/duplicates. No actor, owner, activation or checkpoint fields accepted.

name.description: Trimmed, nonempty UTF-8 name, at most120 encoded bytes; no control characters.

Rule.description: Currently authorized projection of a personal rule. Hidden namespace and job references are omitted; counts distinguish inaccessible and unavailable scopes. Never contains account/directory/principal IDs, activation IDs, feed cursors or private boundaries. Use enabled-only operation to stop a rule with hidden references.

revision.description: Canonical positive signed64-bit decimal; never convert through a floating-point number.

label.description: 1–120 UTF-8 bytes, trimmed, without control characters.

topic.description: Must match an operator-configured topic/environment pair.

revocationReady.description: True only after an acknowledged revocation reservation is activated for this binding. Upgrade-era bindings without a credential cannot deliver push.

Device.description: Safe currently owned binding. No account IDs, binding IDs, private token versions, token material or installation proof. Last seen is informational; no inactivity expiry.

WorkloadPage.description: The total is the sum of available source totals; a partial response is explicitly a subtotal. Each source total retains its observation time.

TargetPage.description: Source-grouped catalog (deployment ID then namespace ID; within source creation time DESC and target ID DESC). At most 200 rows and 2 MiB encoded rows, except a single source-qualified row may use up to 3 MiB; a page may contain fewer rows. Total sums only available source contributions; completeness and sources identify unavailable contributions. Server-held continuations bind account, query, source epoch and authorization.

RulePage.description: Complete bounded traversal of current owned rules, at most20 per page. Follow nextCursor; cursor binds account and limit, expires after10 minutes, and every page reauthorizes current scopes. Concurrent edits are reflected when their page is read; refresh to see additions ordered before the current cursor. Response at most2MiB.

DevicePage.description: Complete current owned list ordered by installation UUID; at most50 bindings/account, no pagination. Encoded response bounded128KiB.

from.description: Display label of the upstream graph node; not its job identity.

to.description: Display label of the downstream graph node; not its job identity.

fromJobId.description: Immutable job UUID of the upstream graph node; used for nodeId filters and topology.

toJobId.description: Immutable job UUID of the downstream graph node; used for nodeId filters and topology.

TargetPartitionPage.description: Generation-pinned partitions in byte-order by name. A changed generation returns target_changed (409); refresh target detail and discard partition cursor history before retrying.

ReportDetail.description: Projection of a reauthorized, fully verified original evidence/report pair; advice is text and never executes actions.

activatedAt.description: Original source-clock activation time, present only while active.

revision.description: Canonical positive signed64-bit decimal; never convert through a floating-point number.

InstallationState.description: Privacy-limited result requiring current authenticated actor plus installation proof. Never identifies the previous owner or their device settings.

installationSecret.description: Canonical unpadded base64url encoding of32 cryptographically random bytes generated and retained in Keychain for this installation. Never put in URL, analytics or logs; never returned.

JobCommand.description: Immutable submitted executable and ordered arguments. Values are untrusted text, not a shell command to execute. Environment values are never included.

JobExecution.description: Detail-only submitted execution specification; not proof of runtime expansion or successful execution. Maximum encoded projection size is 2 MiB.
